verdicts.reason: Both share the same broken layout. The body copy is squeezed into a very narrow right column with a single word or two per line. The 'Shop the Summer Line' CTA is shrunk to a small pill under it. The badges are scattered at bottom-left: 'Award Winning 2026' has no pill and doesn't line up with the others, and the tilted 'Sunset Sale' tag has been moved from the top corner to the bottom. The tiny legal text and a grey 'missing asset' placeholder are left in the lower right. A is less bad because its headline takes 7 balanced lines with room around it. B's headline is bigger and wraps into 10 ragged lines with orphaned words ('All-New', 'Sparkling', 'Gatherings'). It runs almost the full height of the canvas and crowds the body column.
